name: GetQueue
label: Get Queue
description: Retrieves the details of the specified queue by name, including its configuration, input and output schemas, processing statistics (pending, in progress, completed, failed, and total items), access settings, retry policies, and metadata such as creation and last modification information.

fields.name: QueueName
fields.label: Queue Name
fields.description: Specifies the name of the queue to retrieve.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Queue Details
fields.description: Returns the complete queue information, including its configuration, schema, statistics, and metadata.
